onboarding.title: Create a trusted hiring account
onboarding.description: Verify your identity and organisation before accessing recruiter tools.
onboarding.privacyText: Documents are only opened by the administrators reviewing your application and are deleted 30 days after the decision.
onboarding.locked: Your application is with our team, so these details are locked.

account.title: Account registration
account.description: Tell us who will manage this recruiter account.
account.groupDescription: Use professional contact details for the authorised representative.
account.emailHint: Your sign-in email. It cannot be changed.
account.phoneHint: With the country code, or a national number from the country you choose.

company.title: Company information
company.description: Add the registered details we will use to verify your organisation.
company.groupDescription: Enter details exactly as they appear on official records.
company.websiteHint: We add https:// if you leave it out.
company.cityHint: Its country sets your country, currency and formats.
company.registrationHint: Optional where your country does not issue a registration number.

kyc.title: KYC & business verification
kyc.description: Provide evidence that confirms your identity and authority to hire.
kyc.intro: Requirements vary by country. Upload only the identity and business evidence this review needs.

registration.title: Company registration certificate
registration.description: Required business proof or local equivalent.

authorization.title: Authorization proof
authorization.description: Optional unless your authority to represent the company needs evidence.

verify.title: Verify account
verify.description: Confirm your phone number and review the evidence before submitting.
verify.intro: Your work email is already confirmed. Confirm your phone number with the code shown on screen, then submit.
verify.codeShown: Your code is {{code}}. It expires in {{minutes}} minutes.
verify.codeNote: No SMS is sent: the code is shown here.
verify.needsPhone: Confirm your phone number before submitting.
verify.note: Every application is reviewed by a person before recruiter tools open.

review.title: Admin review & approval
review.description: Your application and its review status.
review.pending_reviewText: Your recruiter profile is in the review queue. Access stays locked until an administrator completes the review. We email you when it is decided.
review.rejectedText: Update your details or documents, then resubmit them for review.
review.suspendedText: Recruiter tools are blocked and your jobs are hidden from candidates while the account is suspended.
